title: GHSCI longitudinal series configuration
description: Schema for a longitudinal series configuration file, linking two or more study region configurations representing the same city at different time points.

lookup.description: Stratifier values to join by lookup_id: a path (relative to the process directory) to a CSV table, or an object reading a CSV or Excel workbook (e.g. an original ABS SEIFA release) with a path relative to the project data directory and optional pandas reading options.

data.description: Path relative to the project data directory to a .csv, .xls or .xlsx file.

header.description: Row number (0-based) holding column names; null if there is none (supply names).

skiprows.description: Rows to skip at the start of the table.

skipfooter.description: Rows to skip at the end of the table (e.g. copyright notes).

usecols.description: Columns to read, by name, position or Excel letter range (e.g. 'A,F:G').

names.description: Names assigned to the columns read.

name.description: Name of the city or region represented by this series (e.g. Melbourne).

country.description: Country of the city or region represented by this series.

type.description: Longitudinal (default): timepoints ordered by year.  Sensitivity: scenarios varying a parameter, retained in the order configured.

timepoints.description: Ordered list of study region configurations comprising the series.

region.description: A study region codename (resolved in configuration/regions), or a path to a region configuration file relative to the process directory (e.g. data/AU/AU_Melbourne_2016.yml).

label.description: Display label for this timepoint (e.g. '2016'); defaults to the region's configured year.

year.description: Optional override of the region's configured year, used for ordering and trend estimation.

policy_review.description: Override automatic detection of policy review availability for this timepoint (set false to exclude a review deemed non-comparable).

reference.description: Label or codename of the reference timepoint against which change is evaluated; defaults to the first timepoint.

alignment.description: Expectations and tolerances for grid alignment validation across timepoints.

expect_shared_grid.description: Whether timepoints are expected to share a common population grid (same boundary and raster).

method.description: Alignment method: 'grid_id' joins on grid_id with centroid verification; 'spatial' always builds a nearest-centroid crosswalk.

centroid_tolerance_m.description: Maximum permitted centroid offset in metres between matched grid cells.

min_shared_fraction.description: Minimum shared fraction of grid cells (relative to the smaller grid) below which a warning is issued; below 0.5 an error is raised.

equity.description: Configuration for distributional and stratified equity analysis of change.

thresholds.description: Indicator thresholds for population share analysis: 'default', or a mapping of indicator name to threshold value (or an object with threshold and relationship).

stratification.description: Optional external stratifiers (e.g. an area-level disadvantage index) for stratified analysis of change.

name.description: Name for this stratification (used in output file names).

aggregation.description: Name of a custom aggregation configured in the member region configurations (indicators are read from the corresponding indicators_{name} tables).

lookup_id.description: Column in the lookup table (and aggregation layer) providing a stable area identifier for joining.

stratifier_column.description: Column holding the stratum assignment (e.g. a disadvantage index quintile).

n_groups.description: Number of strata; if the stratifier column is continuous, it is cut into this many population-weighted groups.

reference_timepoint.description: Timepoint whose stratifier values are held fixed across the series (default: the series reference timepoint).

by_timepoint.description: Time-matched stratification: per timepoint label, the aggregation and stratifier source to use for that timepoint (e.g. a census-year disadvantage index for its own areas), overriding the defaults above.  Replaces reference_timepoint.

reporting.description: Reporting configuration for longitudinal report generation (templates, languages, images, output directory).

access_profile.description: Access profile figure style: 'change' superimposes change between the reference and latest timepoints; 'grouped' divides each indicator arm by timepoint; 'markers' draws earlier timepoints as markers over the latest; 'auto' (default) uses 'change' for two timepoints and 'grouped' for more.

output_dir.description: Optional override of the series output directory (default: process/data/_study_region_outputs/{series codename}).
